The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, suggesting that Isotretinoin may influence the activity or expression of GAPDH via the intermediates of 2E2 and 2'-Hydroxymatteucinol. The evidence highlights a possible regulatory or inhibitory role of Isotretinoin on GAPDH, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The pathway is supported by a chain of targets, but the strength of the evidence is moderate, and further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Isotretinoin in GAPDH regulation.
